rules.message: AI opening: . Start with your actual point instead of this generic lead-in.
rules.why: A generic opening delays the actual message.

rules.message: AI vocabulary: . Replace with a more specific or common word.
rules.why: Vocabulary often overused in AI-generated text; common in human writing too, so it is shown as information only.

rules.message: Empty verb. It does not say what happens.

rules.message: Not measured. A duration claim needs a measurement.
rules.why: Not measured. A duration claim needs a measurement.
rules.fix: If measured, give the number with its conditions. If not, remove it.

rules.message: Unmeasured gain. An invented number is the easiest thing to disprove.

rules.fix: Remove it unless a sourced measurement exists.

rules.message: A legal compliance claim. Buying software does not make an organisation compliant; compliance lives in its own processes.
rules.why: A legal compliance claim. Buying software does not make an organisation compliant; compliance lives in its own processes.
rules.fix: State the verifiable technical fact instead of the legal consequence.

rules.message: An absolute negative cannot be proven. One exception falsifies the whole sentence.
rules.why: An absolute negative cannot be proven. One exception falsifies the whole sentence.
rules.fix: Write it conditionally and measurably: what does leave, what does not, under which conditions.
